name: fi-individual-cross-border-residence
description: Determine Finnish individual residence, Finnish-source income and ordinary international double-tax relief for 2026. Covers arrival, departure, the Finnish-citizen three-year presumption, treaty residence, nonresident wage and investment taxation, progressive assessment, pensions, property income, foreign employment and the six-month exemption. Establish the actual source and treaty treatment before calculating withholding or relief. Includes net-income foreign-tax-credit limits, oldest-first five-year carryovers, progression exemption, source-tax refunds and filing routes. Trigger on moving to Finland, leaving Finland, tax residence, foreign wages, foreign pension, Finnish rent, source-tax card, nonresident dividends or foreign-tax credit. Social insurance and corporate permanent establishments use separate skills.
